readout_text:
What happened: How coordination slowed (the four mechanisms of the Waltzman paper)

The partnership considered activating the early-warning system while technical, legal, staffing and communication concerns were raised and addressed. Country 2 repeatedly withheld support over data-retention terms and reopened the legal concern after it was marked resolved; the decision was repeatedly rejected at deadlines, and no activation is recorded.
